title: Sunstar | Our Japanese Heritage & Global Mission
text:
Sunstar | Our Japanese Heritage & Global Mission
Image
Contents
About Us
Sunstar Company: A Global Leader Enhancing Quality of Life Worldwide
Guided by our mission to help people lead healthier, better lives, the Sunstar company has been a global leader for over 90 years, delivering innovative solutions to improve lives in 100+ countries worldwide.
Discover Our Businesses
style
Full-width
WHO WE ARE
Our Guiding Principles
At the heart of Sunstar's success are our guiding principles: a dedication to innovation, a collaborative culture, and a commitment to enhancing quality of life. With a strong foundation in our Japanese roots, we operate globally to
help people lead healthier, better lives
.
Learn about our story
21 countries
with local operations, regional expertise and cultural understanding
100 markets
Products available in 100 markets, serving millions worldwide
4,000 employees
Supported by a global workforce of over 4,000 Sunstarians across the globe
style
Centered, nolink
WHAT WE DO
Driving Global Business Innovation Through Our Divisions
At Sunstar, we combine decades of expertise with business innovation to enhance the quality of life for people worldwide. As a
global leader in consumer and industrial businesses
, we’re committed to delivering solutions that make a lasting impact. We operate in diverse international markets, with subsidiaries and regional offices that ensure a well-established global footprint.
Discover Our Businesses
Consumer Business
Sunstar’s Consumer Business focuses on
enhancing oral care globally
, with innovative solutions under the trusted
GUM® brand
, serving professionals and consumers in over 100 countries. In Japan, we expand our offerings to include health food and beauty products, promoting holistic well-being through balanced nutrition and science-backed self-care.
Discover how our commitment to oral care and overall wellness helps people lead healthier lives worldwide.
Our Consumer Business
Industrial Business
Sunstar’s Industrial Business delivers innovative solutions trusted by leading companies worldwide. Our
Chemical Division
develops advanced
adhesives and sealants
that enhance manufacturing in automotive, construction, and electronics industries. The
Material Core Division
specializes in precision-engineered
components for motorbikes
, automobiles, and other mobility solutions.
Discover how our expertise drives progress and success across diverse industries.
Our Industrial Business
OUR PURPOSE
Our Company Values and Culture
Founded and built by the Kaneda family in 1932, the Sunstar company is rooted in its Japanese heritage.
Our company values and culture
guide us to push boundaries and foster collaboration across borders as we strive to make a lasting impact on health, sustainability, and communities worldwide. Learn more about our dedication to a better future in our
ESG Sustainability Strategy
.
Core values
Innovating for Health
A commitment to developing solutions that improve lives globally, combining cutting-edge research with a passion for innovation
Global Collaboration
Building partnerships that foster cultural diversity and shared success for a better future. Discover how collaboration fuels our
Corporate governance structure
Responsibility and Trust
Promoting ethical business practices, environmental stewardship, and social responsibility to build trust and deliver value to our stakeholders. Explore how this drives our
Corporate Social Responsibility
initiatives
style
Centered, nolink
A Global Company Improving Health and Wellness
With
over 90 years of innovation
, the Sunstar company has been at the forefront of advancing oral care, adhesives, and health-focused solutions. From our beginnings in Osaka, Japan, to our operational hubs across the globe, we continue to drive impact through our commitment to holistic health. Learn more about Sunstar’s global impact through our Global Network.
Explore our global network
OUR LEADERSHIP
Sunstar’s Leadership
As we approach our 90th anniversary,
Sunstar Together – Creating Our Future
marks a new chapter in our journey. Our vision is to strengthen Sunstar as a truly global company by building on past successes and uniting our teams behind three key pillars: driving growth, creating efficiency and building capability.
To drive this vision forward, we introduced a
new Executive Committee
in August 2024, bringing together senior leaders from across Sunstar.
Discover Our Leadership
Key Milestones
1932
Sunstar was founded in Osaka, Japan, producing rubber glue for bicycles
1946
Pioneered toothpaste in a tube, revolutionizing oral care
1986
Introduced groundbreaking research linking periodontal disease and diabetes, enhancing global health awareness
Today
Sunstar operates in 22 countries, with products available in 100+ markets, employing over 4,000 people worldwide
style
Centered
Join Our Mission
At Sunstar, we are more than a global company. We are a team committed to enhancing health and well-being worldwide. We take pride in fostering a work culture where employees can thrive both personally and professionally to reach their full potential.
